detail.longDescription:
Okay. My current “idea keeping me up at night” should receive approval/approbation from you systems folks. 

Imagine! A type-1 hypervisor. No allocator. Can read (but not write) the UEFI version of FAT. The firmware/bootloader passes it a single argument: the name of a config file describing a VM. It then boots up said VM. Errors abort and dump info to the console.
